billing.payAsYouGo: Included with the household away-from-home subscription; no additional relay usage charge.
billing.prepaid: No separate Beebo Relay top-up is required.

beeboRelay.balancePolicy: Separate Beebo Relay usage billing and top-ups are disabled.

ads.note: No ad-supported relay plan is offered.

notes.about: Shared public pricing configuration. Household subscription prices use subscriptionCurrency (CAD). The legacy currency field remains USD for vendor and historical relay-rate fields.
notes.version: Version 4 adds the `tiers` array (two quality-based tiers replacing the old single-tier model). Version 3 compatibility fields (subscriptionMonthly, includedWithSubscription, subscriptionCurrency, householdMaxMembers) are retained and describe tier[0] (the base 1080p tier) for any older client that only reads the flat fields. Older clients must not infer a free subscription from status=free.
notes.tiers: Two household tiers, both up to 6 members, both including Beebo Relay with no extra usage charge, both free for local home use. They differ ONLY in the maximum video quality allowed for AWAY-FROM-HOME (remote) streaming: 'beebo-standard' caps away-from-home playback at 1080p; 'beebo-standard-4k' allows up to 4K away from home. Local/home-network playback is always full quality on both tiers — the cap only applies to the relay/remote path, since that is what uses Beebo Relay bandwidth. `id` matches the Stripe subscription's `beebo_plan` metadata value used by the licensing Worker.
notes.status: free means no additional Beebo Relay usage charge inside the paid household away-from-home plan. It does not make the away-from-home subscription free.
notes.freeAtThisTime: Compatibility flag: no separate relay usage billing. Current copy should say Included with away-from-home access.
notes.subscriptionMonthly: CA$3 per month for the base (1080p) household tier, not per person. See `tiers` for the full two-tier structure including the CA$5/month 4K tier.
notes.subscriptionCurrency: CAD. Applies to subscriptionMonthly, tiers[].monthly and localHomeMonthly. Vendor prices keep their own stated currency.
notes.householdMaxMembers: Six family members in total, including the owner. Same on both tiers.
notes.localHomeMonthly: Zero: local home use does not require a subscription or trial, and is always full quality regardless of tier.
notes.includedWithSubscription: Beebo Relay connection is included in the household away-from-home plan on both tiers. This is not a promise of unlimited bandwidth beyond each tier's stated quality cap.
notes.beeboRelay.costPerGB: Legacy customer-charge field is zero because separate relay usage billing is disabled. This is not Beebo’s infrastructure cost.
notes.beeboRelay.topUp: Disabled. No separate Beebo Relay balance top-up is required.
notes.cloudflare: Optional customer-owned Cloudflare service; Cloudflare bills separately under its own terms. Legacy USD estimates retain their checked date and are not a Beebo charge.
notes.estimates.gbPerHour: Rough data estimates only, not a promised service allowance or a video-quality subscription tier.
notes.ads: Disabled. No advertising credit or ad-funded relay offer is announced.
